{{External|rs}} {{confuse|Ducklings}} {{Infobox Monster |name = Duckling |image = [[File:Duckling.png|200px]] |release = [[29 March]] [[2004]] |update = RS2 Launched! |members = No |combat = 1 |size = 1 |examine = Mini quackers. |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 0 |aggressive = No |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Stab]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 25 |slayxp = 3 |cat = Birds |assignedby = turael,spria |hitpoints = 3 |att = 1 |str = 1 |def = 1 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = -47 |strbns = -42 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = -42 |dslash = -42 |dcrush = -42 |dmagic = -42 |dlight = -42 |dstandard = -42 |dheavy = -42 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id = 2001 }} '''Ducklings''' are smaller versions of [[duck]]s found swimming in the pond north-west of [[Lumbridge]], by [[Farmer Fred]]'s farm, and in the western wing of the [[Farming Guild]]. They will only follow [[Duck#Female|female ducks]]. Occasionally, the female duck will say: {{overhead|Quack?}}, to which any following ducklings respond with: {{overhead|Eep!}}.
